name: Seal of Solomon
lore: The ring given to Solomon by the Archangel Michael, engraved with the true name of God. With it Solomon commanded demons to build the First Temple and bound Asmodeus in a jar of brass. Its power compels obedience — nearby enemies may find themselves frozen in place, unable to act, their will subverted by a force older than anger.
unidentified_name: a bronze ring engraved with a six-pointed star
